description: Articles from the portal blog (portal news, how-tos and tips, waters, fish and nature, readers' stories): title, date, category, short excerpt and URL, newest first, optionally filtered by text or category. Articles are written in Slovak (with translations where available); reader articles are written by anglers.

category.description: Optional category: novinky-portalu = portal news, navody-a-tipy = how-tos and tips, revire-a-vody = waters, ryby-a-priroda = fish and nature, pribehy-od-vody = readers' stories.

lang.description: Language of the answer: texts and page URLs in this language. sk = Slovak (original), cs = Czech, en = English, de = German, pl = Polish, hu = Hungarian, uk = Ukrainian, es = Spanish, fr = French, ro = Romanian, it = Italian. Use the language of the user. If omitted, the language of the input is used when it can be recognised, otherwise Slovak.

name: list_articles
title: Blog articles
